title: Long time, no text
situation: A friend you haven't talked to in months suddenly texts you out of nowhere.
tip: When someone reaches out after a long gap, react first (헐/와) then bounce the same question back so it doesn't feel one-sided.

turns.prompt: React to how long it's been and toss it back

choices.ko: 헐 그러게 ㅋㅋ 너 잘 지냈어?
choices.en: Whoa right lol you been doing okay?
choices.feedback: 맞장구(헐 그러게) plus a follow-up question keeps the chat going naturally.

choices.en: Yes, thank you for reaching out after so long.
choices.feedback: Way too formal (존댓말) for a close friend texting.

choices.en: Okay.
choices.feedback: Too flat and dead-ends the chat with no reaction or question.

turns.ko: ㅇㅇ 그럭저럭? 갑자기 네 생각나서 ㅋㅋ
turns.en: Yeah, more or less? Just suddenly thought of you lol

turns.prompt: Say that's sweet and ask what made them think of you

choices.ko: 오 뭐야 ㅋㅋ 갑자기 왜 내 생각이 났어?
choices.en: Aw what lol what made you think of me?
choices.feedback: Playful reaction plus 되묻기(왜?) digs in and keeps it warm.

choices.en: I'm honored you thought of me.
choices.feedback: Stiff and formal — nobody texts a friend like this.

choices.en: I've been so-so too.
choices.feedback: Ignores what they just said and skips reacting to the 'thought of you' part.

turns.ko: 그냥 옛날 사진 보다가 ㅋㅋ 우리 그때 진짜 자주 봤는데
turns.en: Just looking at old pics lol we used to hang out so much back then

turns.prompt: Agree and admit you miss those days a little

choices.ko: 맞아 ㅋㅋ 그때 진짜 맨날 같이 다녔는데. 좀 그립다, 그치?
choices.en: Right lol we used to hang out every day. I kind of miss those days, don't you?
choices.feedback: It agrees with the memory, then 좀 그립다 returns the friend's warm, nostalgic tone.

choices.en: Photos are personal data, you should be careful.
choices.feedback: Random, formal, and kills the warm vibe completely.

choices.en: Did we hang out a lot back then?
choices.feedback: Just repeats their line as a question instead of agreeing — sounds odd.

turns.ko: ㅇㅇㅇ 우리 조만간 한 번 보자 진짜
turns.en: Yeah yeah, we should actually meet up soon.

turns.prompt: Say yes and nudge toward actually setting it up

choices.ko: 콜 ㅋㅋ 언제 시간 돼? 날 잡자
choices.en: Down lol when are you free? let's pick a day
choices.feedback: 콜 plus pushing to actually set a date turns the vague plan real — very natural.

choices.en: I'll review it positively.
choices.feedback: Corporate/formal phrasing — totally wrong for friends.

choices.en: Yeah we'll meet someday I guess.
choices.feedback: Too lukewarm — brushes off their plan instead of locking it in.

title: So what's new lately?
situation: A friend texts to check in and asks what you've been up to these days.
tip: For the open-ended '요즘 뭐 해?', give one small real detail then volley the question back — that's how friends keep a check-in flowing.

turns.ko: 잘 지내? 요즘 뭐 하고 지내?
turns.en: You good? What've you been up to lately?

turns.prompt: Say you're alright and give a tiny update, then ask back

choices.ko: 어 그냥 회사 다니지 뭐 ㅋㅋ 넌 요즘 어때?
choices.en: Eh just working as usual lol how about you these days?
choices.feedback: Casual self-update plus '넌 어때?' bounces it back perfectly.

choices.ko: 덕분에 잘 지내고 있습니다. 귀하는 어떠신가요?
choices.en: I'm doing well thanks to you. And how are you, sir?
choices.feedback: Extremely formal — '귀하' is business-letter language, not friend talk.

choices.en: What've you been up to lately?
choices.feedback: Just echoes their exact question without answering first — awkward.

turns.ko: 나? 나 요즘 운동 시작했어 ㅋㅋ
turns.en: Me? I started working out lately lol

turns.prompt: React with surprise and ask what kind

choices.en: Oh really? what kind? the gym?
choices.feedback: 진짜? reaction plus a quick follow-up shows interest and keeps it rolling.

choices.en: Exercise is very beneficial for one's health.
choices.feedback: Sounds like a textbook — too formal and doesn't react to them.

choices.en: Ah I see.
choices.feedback: Flat reaction with no follow-up, so the chat fizzles out.

turns.ko: ㅇㅇ 헬스 ㅋㅋ 살 좀 빼려고. 근데 너무 힘들어
turns.en: Yeah the gym lol trying to lose some weight. but it's so hard

choices.ko: 헐 인정 ㅋㅋ 나도 맨날 작심삼일이라 금방 포기해
choices.en: Ugh, same lol I always give up after a few days too.
choices.feedback: 헐 인정 agrees naturally, and the matching experience makes the reply feel mutual.

choices.ko: 체지방 감량을 위해서는 식단 관리가 필수입니다.
choices.en: Diet control is essential for reducing body fat.
choices.feedback: Reads like a fitness lecture — way too stiff for a casual chat.

choices.en: Why are you trying to lose weight?
choices.feedback: Slightly prying and changes the mood instead of just sympathizing.

turns.ko: ㅋㅋㅋ 그치 진짜. 너도 운동 같이 할래?
turns.en: Lol right for real. you wanna work out together too?

choices.ko: 오 좋지 ㅋㅋ 근데 나 게을러서 끌고 가 줘야 돼
choices.en: Oh nice lol, but I'm lazy, so you'll have to drag me along.
choices.feedback: The warm yes and self-deprecating joke fit a close-friend reply.

choices.en: I appreciate the offer but I must politely decline.
choices.feedback: Cold and formal — sounds like declining a meeting invite.

choices.en: You're saying work out together?
choices.feedback: Just repeats their question back instead of giving an actual answer.

title: Miss you, let's hang
situation: A close friend texts that they miss you and want to grab a meal together.
tip: When a friend says they miss you, mirror the warmth (나도!) before talking logistics — don't jump straight to scheduling.

turns.ko: 아 갑자기 너 보고 싶다 ㅠㅠ
turns.en: Ah I suddenly miss you ㅠㅠ

choices.ko: 헐 나도 나도 ㅠㅠ 우리 진짜 오래 못 봤지
choices.en: Aw me too me too ㅠㅠ we really haven't met in ages
choices.feedback: Mirroring with '나도 나도' matches their warmth before any logistics.

choices.en: Thank you for missing me.
choices.feedback: Painfully formal — '감사드립니다' to a close friend is unnatural.

choices.en: Anyway did you gain weight lately?
choices.feedback: Abruptly changes the subject and ignores the sweet moment.

turns.ko: ㅇㅇ 우리 마지막으로 본 게 언제지 ㅋㅋ
turns.en: Yeah when did we even last meet lol

turns.prompt: Guess vaguely and react to how long it's been

choices.ko: 그러게 ㅋㅋ 작년 겨울 아니었나? 와 시간 진짜 빠르다
choices.en: Right lol wasn't it last winter? wow time really flies
choices.feedback: Vague guess plus '시간 빠르다' is exactly the natural reaction here.

choices.ko: 정확한 날짜는 기록을 확인해 봐야 알 수 있습니다.
choices.en: I'd have to check my records for the exact date.
choices.feedback: Robotic and formal — kills the nostalgic, easy tone.

choices.en: When did we last meet?
choices.feedback: Just throws their question back without engaging at all.

turns.ko: ㄹㅇ ㅋㅋ 우리 밥 한 번 먹자 진짜로
turns.en: For real lol, let's actually grab a meal sometime.

turns.prompt: Say yes and ask what they're feeling food-wise

choices.ko: 콜콜 ㅋㅋ 뭐 먹고 싶어? 요즘 땡기는 거 있어?
choices.en: Yes yes lol what do you wanna eat? craving anything lately?
choices.feedback: Enthusiastic yes plus a follow-up about food moves the plan forward naturally.

choices.en: I'll announce the dining schedule separately later.
choices.feedback: Sounds like an office memo — totally wrong register.

choices.ko: 밥은 하루 세 끼 먹어야 좋아.
choices.en: It's good to eat three meals a day.
choices.feedback: Random and unrelated — derails the plan instead of advancing it.

turns.ko: 음 매운 거? ㅋㅋ 떡볶이나 마라탕 어때
turns.en: Hmm something spicy? lol how about tteokbokki or malatang

turns.prompt: Pick one and lock down when

choices.ko: 오 마라탕 좋다 ㅋㅋ 그럼 이번 주말 어때?
choices.en: Oh malatang sounds great lol so how about this weekend?
choices.feedback: Picks a choice and pins down the timing — closes the plan like a real friend.

choices.en: I shall decide on the menu with great care.
choices.feedback: Over-formal and stalls the plan with empty words.

choices.en: Malatang is Chinese food.
choices.feedback: Pointless trivia that ignores their suggestion and the plan.
